reference_sql:
SELECT isodow(timezone('Europe/Amsterdam', timezone('UTC', order_ts))) AS iso_weekday,
       COUNT(*) AS orders
FROM orders
WHERE channel = 'web'
  AND year(timezone('Europe/Amsterdam', timezone('UTC', order_ts))) = 2025
GROUP BY 1
alternatives: SELECT EXTRACT(isodow FROM timezone('Europe/Amsterdam', timezone('UTC', order_ts))) AS iso_weekday, COUNT(*) AS orders FROM orders WHERE channel = 'web' AND timezone('Europe/Amsterdam', timezone('UTC', order_ts)) >= TIMESTAMP '2025-01-01 00:00:00' AND timezone('Europe/Amsterdam', timezone('UTC', order_ts)) < TIMESTAMP '2026-01-01 00:00:00' GROUP BY 1

SELECT CASE WHEN dayofweek(timezone('Europe/Amsterdam', timezone('UTC', order_ts))) = 0 THEN 7 ELSE dayofweek(timezone('Europe/Amsterdam', timezone('UTC', order_ts))) END AS iso_weekday, COUNT(*) AS orders FROM orders WHERE channel = 'web' AND year(timezone('Europe/Amsterdam', timezone('UTC', order_ts))) = 2025 GROUP BY 1

other_way.sql: SELECT CASE WHEN dayofweek(timezone('Europe/Amsterdam', timezone('UTC', order_ts))) = 0 THEN 7 ELSE dayofweek(timezone('Europe/Amsterdam', timezone('UTC', order_ts))) END AS iso_weekday, COUNT(*) AS orders FROM orders WHERE channel = 'web' AND year(timezone('Europe/Amsterdam', timezone('UTC', order_ts))) = 2025 GROUP BY 1
other_way.tradeoff: A CASE that turns dayofweek's Sunday 0 into 7 works, but isodow already counts Monday 1 to Sunday 7.
